Assistant: Sure, here’s a recipe for Zopf:

The ingredients are:

2 cups whole wheat breadcrumbs

1/2 cup water

1 1/2 cups grated fine-quality semolina flour

1/2 cup vegetable oil

2 eggs

3 large egg yolks

3 cups milk

1/4 cup fine-quality semolina flour

3 tablespoons vegetable oil

1 1/2 cups grated fresh swiss chocolate

1 tablespoon butter

Salt and ground nutmeg to taste

1/2 cup chopped pecans (optional)

1. Preheat oven to 400°F.

2. Whisk together whole wheat breadcrumbs and water in a bowl until a paste forms. Add vegetable oil and flour and mix well.

3. Beat together egg yolks, milk, and vegetable oil. Add to the wet ingredients and beat until a thick dough is formed.

4. Knead on a lightly floured surface for five minutes. Turn out on a lightly floured surface and cover. Let rise for one hour in a warm place.

5. Remove cover and punch down firmly. Shape into a disk and cover again. On a lightly floured surface, divide and roll out to approximately 1/4 inch thickness. Cut out shapes of cookies using a cookie cutter. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

6. While dough is rising, make the chocolate sauce by placing chocolate in a medium pot and covering with water. Heat to almost boiling point. Stir in butter. Remove from heat. Remove chocolate skin and stir in milk, nutmeg, salt. Simmer for five minutes. Cool.
7. To make the meringue topping pour egg yolks into a mixing bowl. Add whole milk and vanilla and whisk well. Chill for 30 minutes.

8. To assemble the cookies, turn out to 4-inch log on a work surface, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and chill overnight.

9. Cut log into 4-inch pieces. Roll each piece in the remaining whole wheat breadcrumbs and set aside.

10. To make the meringue, cream egg yolks and whole milk in a large mixing bowl. Add vanilla and whisk.

11. Add the chopped pecans to the mixing bowl, and continue to beat. Then add the cooled chocolate sauce and continue to beat. Whisk in the butter.

12. Divide mixture between four lightly floured cookie sheets. Bake for 4 to 5 minutes.

13. While meringue is baking, make the coffee cream cheese frosting. Beat together cream cheese, mascarpone, egg yolks, and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Gradually add the whole milk, beat well. Add the chopped chocolate, and beat until smooth.

14. To serve, spread half of the meringue on a cookie. Spoon some coffee cream cheese frosting over, and sprinkle with pecans. Dust with powdered sugar and serve.
